scope: Conditional pre-layout electrical delta review for qualified known5V/1.5A USB operation only; not native acceptance or block promotion

findings.message: Independently compared full old/new BoardPlan JSON. Only usb instance revision1→2 and an added USBLC6 bypass note differ. All other blocks,values,nets,physical pins,placements,source references,requirements and firmware bytes remain unchanged. Resolved graph contains53 actual parts.

Loaded and SHA-validated immutable receipt sha256:fde5081a0b45324f436df1a456a1a4dd1608306b862e8a6f4c8187b9d69ac426. Actual importer c_para identifies C14663,Yageo CC0603KRX7R9BB104,Value100nF; decoded physical pads1/2 match the new two-terminal passive capacitor.

usb-c-sink@2 adds C_BUS100nF directly to USBLC6 pin5 VBUS and pin2/GND, plus minimum0.1uF nominal and4mm part-origin screen. Pin5 becomes required power-in on the existing VBUS source. Existing external ports are identical; other values,nets,pin mappings and supplier identities are preserved.

Reopened official ST USBLC6-2 DS4260 Rev7 PDF. Physical page11 Figure17 identifies C_BUS100nF; physical pin map identifies VBUS5/GND2. Added citation agrees. Four millimetres remains an author placement screen, not proof of short transient return/ESD protection.
Current public checkPlan independently rerun on the exact resolved plan: ERC and power both pass with no error issues; schematicHash matches this receipt.

Inherited known5V1.5A USB supply,declared load envelopes,charger programmed-current arithmetic and USB-state regulator assumptions remain mandatory. No battery/supplement/fallback mode,qualified protected pack,thermistor/temperature window,current/thermal transient,audio/LED/display behavior or physical-hardware qualification is established.

This receipt permits pre-layout evaluation only. Fresh exact-identity SPICE,native placement/routing/DRC,physical copper/pad/annulus checks,firmware compile and official shorts/pcb-style checks remain separate. No fabrication order,manufacturing/ESD/EMC/impedance or hardware approval; new USB block remains unreviewed.
